title: Import a workspace
intro: Inspect a Notion export, AppFlowy workspace backup, or Markdown/CSV ZIP, then import the reviewed content into this workspace.
privacy: ZIP inspection runs in your browser. Reviewed page titles, content and databases are sent only after confirmation. Select attachments separately and consent before staging them. The ZIP itself is not uploaded.
limit: Up to 16 MiB. Markdown and CSV are inspected; attachments and unresolved mappings are reported.
tooLarge: Choose a ZIP file of 16 MiB or less.
failed: The export could not be inspected. Check the ZIP format and size.
unsupported: This browser cannot inspect compressed content. Try a supported browser.
review: CSV rows and Markdown pages are not merged automatically. Review candidates and choose only the one-to-one mappings you need.
scope: Pages are created together under a new private folder. Existing pages are not overwritten. Full restoration of sharing permissions, comments, history or database features is not supported.
report: The report contains counts and warnings only, without page content, file names or email addresses.
warning_PREVIEW_ONLY: Inspection does not save data. Import happens only after reviewing the destination and conversion details and confirming.
warning_NOT_FULL_BACKUP: This ZIP may not restore permissions, history, comments, views, formulas or relations completely.
warning_CSV_TYPES_UNCONFIRMED: CSV columns are preserved as text. Property types need review.
warning_ROW_MATCH_UNCONFIRMED: CSV rows and pages have matching titles. Review their mapping.
warning_AMBIGUOUS_ROW_MATCH: More than one row or page has the same title. They are not merged automatically.
warning_ATTACHMENTS_NOT_IMPORTED: Inspection does not save attachments. Select files and confirm their upload separately.
warning_UNSUPPORTED_ENTRIES: The export includes unsupported formats such as HTML or nested ZIP files.
warning_UNRESOLVED_LINKS: Some internal links could not be resolved.
warning_BLOCKED_LINKS: Unsafe links are treated as blocked references.
warning_HTML_AS_TEXT: HTML in Markdown is preserved as text and is not executed.
warning_CSV_FORMULA_AS_TEXT: Formula-like CSV cells are preserved as text and are not executed.
warning_CSV_DUPLICATE_HEADERS: Some CSV headers are empty or duplicated. Their columns are preserved separately.
warning_MARKDOWN_SUBSET: Headings (levels 1-3), paragraphs, nested lists, quotes, code and basic inline styles are converted. Unsupported formatting is preserved in the source; full formatting is not reproduced.
signInRequired: Sign in with a verified account to import. Inspection is available without signing in.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are not enabled on this server. ZIP inspection is still available.
contentDisabled: Workspace storage is not available on this server. ZIP inspection is still available.
connectionFailed: Your account or destination could not be checked. Your input and inspection result have been kept.
unverified: Verify your email before selecting a destination.
signIn: Sign in in a new tab
noWorkspaces: You have not joined a workspace. Create one in the account screen, then check again.
createWorkspace: Create a workspace in a new tab
privateBranch: The new folder and pages will be accessible only to you. Source sharing permissions are not imported.
bundleLimit: Each import supports up to 100 pages including the folder, and 256000 bytes of request data. Preserved source data counts toward this limit.
sendBoundary: Save the reviewed page titles, content, databases and staged attachments as new private pages in the selected workspace. The ZIP itself is not uploaded.
ack_csvReference: I understand that CSV data becomes text reference pages, without conversion into databases, property types, formulas or relations.
ack_linksUnconverted: I understand that unresolved links stay as source text. External links and attachment references may need to be configured again.
ack_excludedAssets: I understand that attachments and unsupported formats will not be saved. I will keep the source ZIP separately.
consent: I have reviewed the destination, folder name, counts and conversion limits, and agree to save these as new private pages.
success: Saved under a new private folder. Existing pages were not overwritten.
successReplayed: The same import was already saved. No duplicate pages were created.
reviewRetry: Review retry of the same content
sameRequest: The same content and request identifier will be reused to check the result without creating duplicates.
uncertain: The save result could not be confirmed. Your file and content have been kept. Retry the same content to check the result. It is not sent again automatically.
sessionExpired: Your session could not be verified. Sign in again with the same account. Your file and inspection result have been kept.
accountChanged: This import is stopped because the account changed. Return to the original account and check again.
guest: Guests cannot import into a workspace. Choose another destination.
accessChanged: This destination is unavailable. Membership or access may have changed. Your content has been kept.
conflict: The destination has changed. The import is not sent again automatically. Check the destination and review your confirmation again.
reviewRefreshed: The latest destination revision was checked. Confirm the conversion limits and reviewed content again.
bundleTooLarge: The import exceeds the storage limit. Split it into requests of at most 256000 bytes including preserved source data.
tooManyPages: Split the ZIP into imports with up to 100 pages including the folder.
noContent: There are no pages or databases available to import.
acksRequired: Confirm the conversion limits and reviewed content.
invalidPlan: The content could not be prepared. Check the inspection result, folder name and import limits.
applyFailed: The import could not be completed. Your file and reviewed content have been kept.
locked: The sent content and destination stay fixed until the save result is confirmed.
editAgain: Return to inspection and destination settings
warningUnknown: Some items are unsupported. Keep the source data separately and review the content.
bundleWarning_SOURCE_PRESERVED: Source Markdown and CSV text are also preserved as collapsed, read-only reference data.
bundleWarning_MARKDOWN_SUBSET: Headings (levels 1-3), paragraphs, nested lists, quotes, code and basic inline styles are converted. Unsupported formatting is preserved in the source; full formatting is not reproduced.
bundleWarning_CSV_REFERENCE_ONLY: CSV data is saved as readable text reference pages, without conversion into native databases.
bundleWarning_LINKS_UNCONVERTED: Unresolved links stay as original text.
bundleWarning_ASSETS_EXCLUDED: Attachments and unsupported formats are not saved. Keep the source ZIP separately.
bundleWarning_MATCHES_NOT_MERGED: Unselected CSV rows and Markdown pages are not merged automatically, even when their names match.
bundleWarning_PERMISSIONS_NOT_IMPORTED: Source sharing permissions, comments and history are not carried over. New pages are saved under your private folder.
csvNativeHint: All columns start as text, with a page for each row. Edit values in the table and refer to original cell values. Types, formulas, views and relations are not restored.
csvReferenceHint: Keep CSV as readable reference pages and source JSON. Table value editing is not available in this mode.
noMappingCandidates: There are no mapping candidates. A new page will be created for each CSV row.
rowMappingTitle: Map CSV rows to pages ({count} selected)
rowMappingHint: Matching names never merge automatically. Each Markdown page can be selected for one row only. Unselected rows get a new page.
invalidMapping: The mappings contain a duplicate page or a cycle. Review the selected mappings.
ack_csvTextTypes: I understand that every database column is imported as text. Formulas, relations, original property types and views will not be restored.
bundleWarning_CSV_TEXT_TYPES: CSV columns start as text. Formulas, relations, original types and views are not restored.
bundleWarning_COLUMN_NAMES_NORMALIZED: Empty or duplicate column names receive unique names. Original headers and cell values remain available as reference data.
bundleWarning_INTERNAL_LINKS_CONVERTED: Resolved internal links point to the newly imported pages.
bundleWarning_ROW_MAPPINGS_APPLIED: The selected CSV rows are mapped to Markdown pages. Source data is kept for reference.
attachmentsHint: Select files and confirm their upload separately. Preparing attachments and saving pages are separate steps. Up to 100 files and 64 MiB in total.
assetSendBoundary: The selected attachment contents will be uploaded to the specified workspace on this server. The entire ZIP is not uploaded.
assetStagingBoundary: This step prepares private attachments. They cannot be opened from pages until you confirm the final page save. Cancel preparation before changing the destination or mappings.
assetConsent: I have reviewed the destination, file count and size, and agree to upload the selected attachments to this server.
preparingAssetBytes: Preparing the selected files in this browser…
assetPhase_prepared: The attachment contents are ready for upload.
assetPhase_uploaded: {count} attachments are ready. Continue to the final page review.
assetPhase_rechecked: The destination state has been checked. You can resume preparing the same attachments.
assetPhase_conflict: The destination changed. Nothing is sent again automatically.
assetPhase_uncertain: The preparation result could not be confirmed. The same content has been kept.
assetPhase_forbidden: Attachment preparation is unavailable. Check the original account and its access.
assetPhase_failed: Attachments could not be prepared. Your selections have been kept.
assetPhase_committed: Attachments were saved with the pages.
assetAwaitingPages: Attachments cannot be cancelled while the page save result is uncertain. Confirm the result of the same import first.
assetConflict: The destination changed. Check its state before resuming the same preparation.
assetsTooLarge: Attachments are limited to 100 files, 16 MiB each and 64 MiB in total per import.
invalidAssets: The selected attachments could not be prepared. Check their count, size and file names.
assetContextChanged: The attachment preparation state changed. Complete cancellation before starting again.
assetFailed: The attachment result could not be confirmed. The content has been kept and is not sent again automatically.
assetPhase_cancel-uncertain: The cancellation result is uncertain. Retry the same cancellation.
attachmentsDisabled: Attachment storage is not configured on this server. Pages can still be imported without attachments.
bundleWarning_ASSETS_INCLUDED: Prepared attachments are saved as downloads governed by the pages that reference them.
assetReadyReviewFailed: The attachments are ready, but the page review could not be prepared. Check the import limits. Cancel preparation before changing the settings.
sourceAppFlowy: AppFlowy — workspace backup / Markdown and CSV ZIP
notionFormatHint: Choose a Notion Markdown and CSV export. Notion ID suffixes are removed from display names.
appflowyFormatHint: Choose an AppFlowy workspace backup ZIP or a Markdown/CSV ZIP. Native JSON is converted into pages, hierarchy, supported content and tables. Internal collaboration binaries are not executed.
appflowyPortableRequired: No supported AppFlowy backup metadata or Markdown/CSV content was found. Choose a workspace ZIP exported by AppFlowy or a Markdown/CSV ZIP.
warning_APPFLOWY_PORTABLE_ONLY: Only AppFlowy Markdown and CSV are converted. Native backups, JSON configuration and internal databases are not restored.
warning_APPFLOWY_UNREFERENCED_FILES: Files not referenced by Markdown are excluded. Internal data and configuration are not sent as attachments.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
appflowyLimit: AppFlowy backups: ZIP up to 64 MiB and 64 MiB expanded, with up to 8 MiB of native JSON. Markdown/CSV ZIPs remain limited to 16 MiB.
appflowyTooLarge: Choose an AppFlowy backup ZIP no larger than 64 MiB.
appflowyInvalidBackup: This AppFlowy backup could not be read. Check its format, integrity, size and conflicting duplicate data. No content has been saved.
nativeImportMode: AppFlowy identifiers determine duplicates and hierarchy. Supported content and databases are imported into a new private folder. Table values stay text; field types, formulas and saved views are not restored.
nativeBundleLimit: Native imports allow up to 500 pages including the root folder and 768000 bytes of request data. The destination workspace capacity also applies.
nativeBundleTooLarge: The converted data exceeds 768000 bytes. Choose a backup of a smaller workspace or the pages you need.
nativeTooManyPages: The converted data exceeds 500 pages including the root folder. Choose a smaller workspace backup.
nativeReview: Objects with the same identifier are checked for matching content before deduplication. Sharing permissions, comments, history and collaboration state are not imported.
ack_nativeSubset: I understand that supported AppFlowy content, hierarchy and text-valued tables are converted, without fully restoring types, views or collaboration history.
warning_APPFLOWY_NATIVE_SUBSET: Content and hierarchy are converted from AppFlowy JSON. Sharing permissions, history and collaboration binaries are not imported.
bundleWarning_APPFLOWY_NATIVE_SUBSET: Content and hierarchy are converted from AppFlowy JSON. Sharing permissions, history and collaboration binaries are not imported.
warning_NATIVE_DATABASE_TEXT: Databases become text-valued tables. Original types, views and formula settings remain available as reference data.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_DATABASE_TEXT: Databases become text-valued tables. Original types, views and formula settings remain available as reference data.
warning_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK: Unsupported blocks are retained in read-only source JSON. Their display may need to be recreated.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK: Unsupported blocks are retained in read-only source JSON. Their display may need to be recreated.
warning_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported formatting, including text and background colors, remains in the source JSON.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Unsupported formatting, including text and background colors, remains in the source JSON.
warning_NATIVE_UNRESOLVED_LINK: References without a confirmed target are not activated as links. Their source data is retained.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_UNRESOLVED_LINK: References without a confirmed target are not activated as links. Their source data is retained.
warning_NATIVE_ASSETS_EXCLUDED: Attachments that you have not selected and staged are excluded. Keep the original ZIP.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_ASSETS_EXCLUDED: Attachments that you have not selected and staged are excluded. Keep the original ZIP.
warning_NATIVE_VIEW_REFERENCE: Additional views of the same database become reference pages. Reconfigure their view settings after import.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_VIEW_REFERENCE: Additional views of the same database become reference pages. Reconfigure their view settings after import.
warning_NATIVE_ROW_LOCATION: Row content moves under its database, with a reference page retained at its previous location.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_ROW_LOCATION: Row content moves under its database, with a reference page retained at its previous location.
warning_NATIVE_ORPHAN_BLOCK: Blocks unreachable from the content tree remain in the original source JSON.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_ORPHAN_BLOCK: Blocks unreachable from the content tree remain in the original source JSON.
warning_NATIVE_HIERARCHY_DETACHED: Self-parented pages are placed under the new import folder. Confirmed row pages are connected to their databases.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_HIERARCHY_DETACHED: Self-parented pages are placed under the new import folder. Confirmed row pages are connected to their databases.
nativeWorkspaceTooLarge: The destination workspace has insufficient capacity. Choose a new empty workspace or reduce its existing content. The content present before this import has not changed.
warning_NATIVE_SELECT_LABELS: Selection identifiers were converted to their configured display names as text. The original identifiers remain in the source reference data.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_SELECT_LABELS: Selection identifiers were converted to their configured display names as text. The original identifiers remain in the source reference data.
warning_NATIVE_SELECT_UNRESOLVED: Some selection labels could not be resolved reliably. Their original values are retained without dropping selections. Review the source reference data if needed.
bundleWarning_NATIVE_SELECT_UNRESOLVED: Some selection labels could not be resolved reliably. Their original values are retained without dropping selections. Review the source reference data if needed.
